task.question: What line of the Nanjing Metro opens in April 2026?
task.evidence: 22 April – Line S2 of the Nanjing Metro opens between Xishanqiao station and Taibai station.

answer:
The Nanjing Metro Line 6 is set to open in September 2026. There is no specific line mentioned to open in April 2026. 

FINAL: No line opens in April 2026

[Nanjing Metro] The Nanjing Metro is a rapid transit system serving the urban and suburban districts of Nanjing, the capital city of Jiangsu Province, China. Proposals for a metro system serving Nanjing first began in 1984, with approval by the State Planning Commission granted in 1994. Construction began on the initial 16-station Line 1 in 1999, and opened in 2005. The system has 16 lines and 272 stations running on 658.1 km (408.9 mi) of track. It is operated and maintained by the Nanjing Metro Group Company. Future expansion plans include 30 lines set to open within the next few years, with several more awaiting approval to begin construction.

[Line 6 (Nanjing Metro)] Line 6 of the Nanjing Metro is a north-south line. The earliest plan was to commence operation in 2024, but it was later moved to the end of 2025, then expected to begin in the third quarter of 2026. The line officially opened on 29 September 2026. The line through-operates with Line S1 to Konggangxinchengjiangning and has a twice-daily through service with Line S7.
